description: Streamlit app for displaying news headlines and stories from various sources using OpenBB SDK, with user interface controls for filtering and fetching news data.

methods.name: fetch_openbb
methods.description: Fetches news data from selected provider using OpenBB SDK based on user session state.

methods.name: update_data
methods.description: Updates the session state's news data by calling fetch_openbb.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to render the news headlines and stories interface.
